notes.title: Play an exclusive demo only during Nextfest!
notes.content:
[h1]LightBreak Demo Update: Version 0.0.6 - Steam NextFest Special[/h1]

[b]We're thrilled to announce that LightBreak is part of Steam NextFest! This exclusive build is available only during the event, so dive in and experience the latest enhancements and features we've crafted just for you.[/b]

[h3]Update Notes for Version 0.0.6:[/h3]
Steam NextFest Build:

[b]Procedural Puzzles Everywhere:[/b] Both tuning and sorting puzzles are now procedurally generated, offering a fresh challenge every time you play.

[b]New Exclusive NextFest Content![/b] A new level has been added to the demo, expanding your journey.
[b]Level 7 Memory Fragments Update:[/b] The beam is now integrated with the memory fragment environment, allowing players to rotate the scene while the beam is travelling to get a better perspective.

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[b]Melody Generator:[/b] In the harmony phase, enjoy a unique song-like rhythm generated by our new automated system.
[b]Musician Mode: [/b]For those seeking a challenge, you can now disable visual cues in audio puzzles. Visual cues are enabled by default for a more guided experience.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[b]Lighting Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue with Lumen to eliminate harsh lighting effects.
[b]Note Interaction:[/b] Fixed a bug where players could get locked out due to note interaction and correctness checks.
[b]Gamepad Compatibility:[/b] Hotfix applied to make Level 7 mirrors compatible with gamepads.
[b] Tons of Stability fixes! [/b]

[h2]Join us during Steam NextFest and explore the latest LightBreak demo. Add it to your wishlist and be part of our journey as we continue to refine and expand the game. Let's make music and solve puzzles together![/h2]

notes.title: We are attending more events! - Demo Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! It's Celebration time! [/h1]

to close out our bombastic few weeks of updates and festivals, we'll be attending the new and exciting [b]Back to School Celebration! [/b]
We're releasing a small patch to the game demo that brings a few bug fixes, and new features into the mix! 

[h2]Patch 0.0.4:[/h2]
- Memory fragments: Gameplay Improvements in Demo Level 1 and Demo Level 2 - Objects now react realistically to guide the player towards the correct interaction. 
- Increased Mirror collider sizes on Demo Level 1, this would prevent accidental zoom-outs when users click on its edges 
- Implemented Zoom: now you can zoom into the memory fragment scenes to find hidden objects and secrets easier, and appreciate the finer details! Use your mouse scroll wheel or gamepad Triggers to zoom in and out! 
- Note Shifting Rework: The notes now dynamically react to being moved or pushed around. 

[h1]When is the next Event?[/h1]
We're in the process of application to a few other events, but for now, we can tell you that on October 4-6, we'll be in Atlanta for DREAMHACK!

[h2]We will see you in person in Dreamhack Atlanta this October![/h2]
[h3]Use our Discount Code DEEVINTERACTIVE to get [b]15% Discount[/b] on your tickets![/h3]

notes.title: LightBreak Demo Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]LightBreak Demo Update: Version 0.0.3[/h1]

We've just rolled out a fresh update to the *LightBreak* demo on Steam, just in time for RHYTHM FEST! We're excited to introduce new features and enhancements based on player feedback and our ongoing commitment to improving gameplay.

[h2]Update Notes for Version 0.0.3:[/h2]

[h3]New Levels Preview:[/h3] Dive into three newly added levels from the mid-game, designed to challenge your puzzle-solving skills and deepen your engagement with the game's core mechanics.

[h3]Enhanced Audio Experience:[/h3] We've added more sound effects and improved the quality of concurrent audio playback. Get ready for a richer and more immersive auditory environment.

[h3]Memory Fragments Mechanic:[/h3] Explore mind-bending environmental audio puzzles in the latest feature, Memory Fragments. Use your knowledge of the game's lore and creative problem-solving skills to uncover new aspects of Ava's story.

[h3]User Interface Improvements:[/h3] We've implemented bug fixes and added new options to the menu, including:
[h3]Skip Sorting:[/h3] Stuck on a tough audio puzzle? Now you can skip challenging segments directly from the pause menu—no catch!
[h3]Level Restart:[/h3] Encounter a bug? Restart your level with ease from the in-game menu.

[h3]Save & Load Game with Steam Cloud Integration:[/h3] New checkpoint system saves your progress at the end of each level. All save files are now synchronized with Steam Cloud, ensuring your progress is saved and loaded seamlessly.

[h3]Core System Optimizations:[/h3] Focused optimizations have improved performance on the Steam Deck, boosting frame rates from 15 FPS to a steady 40+ FPS. This update brings performance enhancements across all supported systems, ensuring smoother gameplay for everyone.

[h2]Endless Puzzles:[/h2]
At the beginning of each level, the game procedurally generates a new, unique puzzle every time. 
This means you can endlessly replay the game with new audio puzzles to complete! 

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Reworked core system scripts to reduce the chances of notes spawning inside each other 
Tutorial texts now adjust according to camera angles for better visibility and instruction clarity.

[h2]Performance Enhancements:[/h2]
Continued optimization efforts for frame-time stability on the Steam Deck. While the game is fully playable, our target is to eliminate any remaining frame drops in future updates.

Join us on Steam and add *LightBreak* to your wishlist today! Let's make some music and solve puzzles together!

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384970/LightBreak/]Wishlist on Steam Today![/url][/h3]

notes.title: LightBreak Demo Updated with new features - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38467768/fcd6fe65025644a2c22e69fc48d43b78f09189d6.png[/img]

[h2]LightBreak's demo was updated [/h2]
following the feedback from players and our telemetry data via steam. 
We're looking to build the most engaging version of the game and iterate on the game's pacing through rigorous testing in our Free demo. 

[h3]Update Notes for version 0.0.2:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Preview of Memory Fragments: [/b]Access spatio-aural puzzles related to ava's memories in level 7. You can play the teaser for this mechanic by searching the environment for related sounds, and manipulate physics events to create the desired sounds. (for example, drag a candle on some dry wood to create the sound of fire!)

[*] [b]Game Difficulty Adjustments: [/b]The first few levels are aimed to teach players the core mechanics, their length has been adjusted.
Difficulty now dynamically increases from level 5 and beyond. This includes faster timing and more melodic and instrumental variety. 

[*] [b]Let It Be: [/b] If you're stuck on a particularly difficult melodic facet, you can press "Let It Be" in the pause menu to skip it. For now, Let It be has unlimited uses. 

[*] [b]Game feel enhancements: [/b]
[olist]

    [*] Swapping Notes now dynamically plays different animations depending on the direction of the final destination. 
    [*] Other Notes move reactively to predict where the player wants to drop the grabbed note.  
    [*] The grabbed note communicates with other notes to determine the best time to move back into its destination. 
    [*] Camera movement smoothing are now through eased tween animations 
    [*] The Tuning peg audio no longer cuts itself off, and game's audio now stacks correctly on top of itself so playing many notes in quick succession sounds a lot more natural 
    [*] Reworked core system hierarchy to make sure elements are always centered on the screen 
    [*] Cutscenes have Parallax depth wherever appropriate. This is done through a smart automatic system. 
[/olist]

[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[olist]
    [*] Fixed an issue where players would finish interaction with the Saaz but the game did not detect all of the puzzles have been solved. 
    [*] Fixed an issue where the tutorial texts would appear in inappropriate camera angles, they now are fully aware of the state of the camera. 
    [*] Synced the behavior of the game mechanics across input methods, now the game should work identically with mouse and various input controllers. 
    [*] Game Optimizations for frame-time stability on the Steam Deck. We're only beginning to investigate performance on the steam deck. while the game is entirely playable, some areas can experience frame drops. This will be fixed in the upcoming updates. 
[/olist]

[/list]
